implementation.duration_scope: Explicit reviewed_case_estimate with declared point/upper/unknown only; no trained historical duration estimator or clinical duration guarantee.
implementation.independent_patients_and_resources: Selected patient segments are independent from rooms, concrete people/roles and concrete equipment slots. Shared people across roles and shared devices across quantity slots conflict.
implementation.qualification_and_scope: No inferred physical identity, duty, qualification, availability or coverage from names, titles, Doctor aliases, assistant text, legacy room strings or current equipment status. Empty role requirements remain unknown.
implementation.search_scope: Conservative and optimistic graphs preserve unknowns, exact bounds, stopping reasons and proof status. Nonmonotone adjacent transitions/costs are not pruned as if monotone. Unknown busy facts relax affected optimistic adjacency costs and gaps together.
implementation.professional_and_super_governance: Actual current professional attestation is separate from technical Super approval. Published roots/scenarios do not enable the feature or establish operational validation.
implementation.outbound: Complete typed public Source plus full Prompt provenance only; private identity mappings, free questions and original notes stay local. No automatic booking, schedule publication, surgery start, stock, billing or clinical-state writes.
implementation.storage: Short canonical task/evidence/context anchors fit existing TEXT fields; full private scenario and accepted result use separate bounded MEDIUMTEXT. Current lease, original bindings, result pointer, success state and audit accept atomically.
implementation.live_checks: Queue, pre-inference, acceptance, post-write checks, ordinary history and feedback recheck actual original permissions/collections/configuration. Native markers are checked independently of a mutable feature discriminator; Super may inspect own-byte-consistent frozen audit.
implementation.known_scope_gap: v1 has no curated external-patient-busy original. Relevant legacy selected-patient schedules produce legacy_patient_busy_not_curated/input_unknown; they are not silently treated as complete reviewed reservations.
implementation.guide: doc/ai-guide.md#明确病例与阶段资源的手术候选排程第65项

native_core.container_scope: Actual authenticated HTTP with 24 distinct math cases plus one Prompt change; 1 CPU/512MiB, network none, read-only, non-root UID10001, no host ports/source mounts/hospital database. Host/container environment identities recorded separately.
native_core.limits: 256 required cases execute; amplified 8192 references/8192 segments rejects early without OOM and service remains ready. Standalone core tests and independent oracle are separate targeted evidence, not added to 6670 backend count.

sql_unicode_blob_capacity.scope: database capacity and exact bytes only; no runtime worker/result-schema acceptance claim

database.migration_scope: Real isolated MySQL8.0.39 up/down/up of both exact migrations and all ten populated new tables, 185 existing metadata tables and full original DDL/rows preserved. Unicode capacity SQL blob is storage-only, not a typed native pipeline.
database.legacy_scope: Actual three MySQL connections and real legacy controller calls verify Gate-first lock waits, cancelled-parent protection under old repeatable-read snapshots, role revocation and child cancellations. This is not a JWT/native-worker/full-MySQL pipeline claim.
database.isolation: Network none, private Unix socket, no host ports, no project .env or hospital database. One optional bind attempt is explicitly blocked before I/O in recorded guards; no claim of zero attempted socket binds. Temporary resources cleaned.

actual_governance_worker_pipeline.scope: Actual synthetic governed SQLite originals/scenarios, JWT/ASGI routes, persistent claims, independent native ASGI, complete results, errors/cancellation/permission/source invalidation and SQL/audit rollback. Includes selected prior regressions; not added to full backend count or called MySQL deployment.

frontend_build.route_change: Constrain actual dynamic route context to views; preserve Layout/EmptyLayout/nested metadata/404 behavior, tested against actual resolver inputs and real static routes. Whole-src dynamic context previously bundled APIs/components/JSON unnecessarily; no claim of controlled byte savings across concurrently changing builds.

frontend_browser.scope: Production pages and isolated parent/component harnesses intercept synthetic API replies. Only request-real-http.spec.js performs the existing actual synthetic loopback transport tests. Backend native worker/ASGI, containers, MySQL and independent oracles are separate evidence, not counted as browser model inference or clinical/operational validation.

targeted_frontend_evidence_not_added_aga.legacy_parent_scope: Three prior Node-driven isolated Vue parent suites, not production UI or browser full-run additions. Source was not frozen at their start; this limit remains recorded.

node_tools.scope: Actual existing Node tooling and dynamic-route resolver; 14 route cases are already inside 44.

platform_inventory.source_capture_limit: Test files and synthetic fixture provenance are captured by exact bytes. Inventory performs no tests and does not attest that any changed test matched an earlier run.

broad_default_browser_collection.scope: Root stopped its owned runner after detecting the overly broad default collection. 939 report skipped includes the interrupted case and unexecuted cases; 980 are collected entries, not completed executions. Fresh final2 explicitly scopes all 77 previous/new AI files and independently passes all 890 without retry.

preserved_attempts.other_attempts: Original source/protected UI, production bootstrap fixture/ARIA, route/build diagnostics, migration fixture omissions and exception-class correction, evidence-script scope assertions and all predecessor logs are retained in /tmp with targeted owner reports. They are not added to final passing counts. Product and actual operational validation status were never relaxed to obtain a pass.

artifact_retention: Raw /tmp logs/reports/fixture exports are referenced by absolute paths and SHA256; they are not permanently packaged in Git. This committed record preserves their bindings and scope, not a promise that temporary artifacts persist.
limitations: Synthetic engineering checks do not establish clinical accuracy, prospective operational performance, historical data availability, complete patient-busy coverage, deployment readiness for a particular hospital, or all80 goal completion.
No actual hospital schema migration, service deployment, real business AI enablement or patient-data inference was performed.
